Professional ethics
Valuation of variations
Cost consultant
items.s: Cost consultant is the role in which the surveyor advises the client on cost and value.

the priced document listing measured items of work with descriptions and quantities
a change to the work after the contract has been agreed
the settled statement of the total cost of a project at completion
